name: Cuirass
what_i_did: Lorica segmentata as hoops and plates: 7 overlapping girth hoops, chest and yoke plates round a neck opening, breast and back plates, 3 shoulder lames per side, and the front seam.
good: Outline match 0.92, the best of the six: the stacked girth hoops, the shoulder lames and the neck opening all line up.
Hollow, with open neck and arm holes, so it can sit on a body.
Each hoop is its own piece, so the armour can flex or be dented hoop by hoop later.
off: The concept's hoops have a stronger downward overlap and soft folded edges; mine are cleaner, stiffer bands.
At about 6.8k triangles it is the heaviest part; the hoops could share geometry if the budget gets tight.
creative_additions: A centre seam down the front where the two halves meet, as on real segmentata.

rounds.t: First build: 7 hoops, chest and yoke, breast and back plates.
Shoulder lames, 3 per side, stacked over the yoke; neck opening widened.
Seams and facet pass; final render and score.

score.method: silhouette IoU after bounding-box normalising both masks; camera found by grid search on the model, so a guide
